_comment: App translation catalogue. Loaded by libs/lib_i18n.py (fn600-fn606). 'fields' keys are RAW dataset column names; 'ui' keys are app-chrome string ids. A missing key falls back to the English label the app already computes (lib_revalu_map.FIELD_LABELS, then aux_10__ui_config.json -> column_display_labels, then lib_data.fn128_clean_column_name). ENG is therefore intentionally sparse: it only overrides labels that differ from those defaults.

values._comment: Dataset VALUE translations, keyed by the raw column the value comes from, then by the English value exactly as stored. Lookup is exact first, then case-insensitive (libs/lib_i18n.fn708). These are display-only: filtering, grouping and every per-product-type rule still run on the English value. The Product Type map also feeds the derived D__ProductType_ITA column (libs/lib_i18n.fn710), the counterpart of the D__MaterialType_ITA column already in the dataset.

pages._comment: Navigation entries (app.py -> st.navigation) and the in-page tab menus, keyed by the English title as written in the code.

card_labels._comment: Catalogue card detail-row labels (aux_07__js2_card_fields.json -> detail_rows[].label / labels_by_size). Keys are the English label as written in that file; libs/lib_i18n.fn707 swaps them in the payload injected as window.__JS2_FIELDS__.
